review_scope: Read-only review of vLLM collector branch and vLLM engine reuse capability gate; no implementation edits by reviewer.

findings.description: Decode recorded step=seq_len although BatchSpec already includes the one new token; MLA and DSA loaders use isl+step, placing each observation at seq_len+1.
findings.resolution: step=seq_len-1; tests assert total coordinates for both MLA and DSA.

lifecycle_review: Full dry run fills the shared native top-k buffer before either benchmark.
Full and skip are separate graph captures; native skip_topk only bypasses the indexer.
The original flag is restored by ExitStack before vLLM contexts unwind and workspace cleanup runs.
Skip capture failure propagates and emits no skip row; a preceding successful full observation can remain.
Graph timing is required, with eager/fallback results rejected before publication.

independent_test.limitations: Framework behavior is faked in these CPU tests; GPU native qualification is a separate receipt. Initial invocation without confcutdir failed importing the uninstalled package before collecting tests.

findings.description: A full fallback bucket could exist in skip data while the skip query preferred a different requested backend. The initial gate permitted mixing these independent resolutions.
findings.resolution: Require selected skip backend to equal selected full backend; reverse-asymmetry fixture covers both context and generation.

checks: Architecture, attention/GEMM/KV precision and local heads must match.
Both independent backend fallback resolutions must match.
Missing skip data preserves the full estimate; corrupt skip tables still error.
Only vLLM gains the stricter capability gate in this patch; existing SGLang count logic is unchanged.

limits: Review does not qualify all GPU precisions/shapes or checkpoint-value timing parity.
No review claim that new rows improve whole-model accuracy before corresponding measurements and native SDK validation.
